thread:
maria: noticed a weird spike in quota attribution for a small set of origins around 16:02 UTC. looks like auth-proxy pathing reused stale claim metadata. can anyone confirm?
jon: can you paste the curl/log sample? wondering if it's happening for project keys or ephemeral SAs.
tariq: quick grep shows it's ephemeral SA tokens: `auth_proxy: token_id=tok_aa12 claim_checksum=0x9f3a ttl=30s cache_ttl=90s` -> cache_ttl > ttl so requests after token expiry still labeled with same claim.
samantha: that would inflate request counts vs tokens issued. console quota dashboard shows requests>issued for the claim_checksum. we should flag that in the dashboard UI as "claim mismatch" and link to runbook.
maria: agree. telemetry plan: add `claim_checksum` label to `api_requests_total` and a counter `auth_proxy_claim_stale_rewrites`. roll this behind a flag and run 1% canary.
jon: will add label + flag `auth.proxy.claim_labeling` and a new metric. deployment plan: auth-proxy/canary 1% -> monitor 30m. if `auth_proxy_claim_stale_rewrites` > 0 take snapshot and keep canary but increase sampling.
tariq: promql to detect anomaly: `sum by (claim_checksum, token_type) (increase(api_requests_total{handler="proxy"}[5m])) > sum by (claim_checksum, token_type) (increase(token_issued_total[5m]))` will surface claims with over-attribution.
samantha: UX: add a small alert pill on quota dashboard rows where requests/issued > 1 with tooltip: "Possible auth-proxy claim TTL mismatch. See runbook."
maria: rollout gates: require <0.1% error rate and no p50 latency regressions. if any `claim_stale_rewrites` detected, escalate sampling for that origin to 10% and open a follow-up triage.
jon: PR upcoming. i'll include the prometheus rule, dashboard annotation, and feature flag config.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: auth-proxy/canary -> k8s-redwood/us-east-1 (id: deploy-2026-05-12-013) :rocket:
tariq: i'll run the promql in staging now and post graphs in ~45m.
